text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hah! …Ugh, damn, still not good enough. 
I'm too slow! I gotta match C.B.'s flip!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(But if I go faster,
my movements get all sloppy… I just can't
do it like Maruzen and Rudolf can.)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Wait,
I still have to practice my writing more
too. 
Sheesh… there's so damn much to d— woah?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yo. Don't you think you're overdoing it?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: …Got it. Thanks, C.B…

I swear,
you're always goin' off and doing something
crazy without thinking twice!
It's hard to keep up when you do that,
y'know.
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Can't help it. When I look at you,
I just get the urge.
So… doesn't that mean you're the one at
fault here?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
But… you probably wouldn't be down 
if I did something even crazier, huh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh? Hahahaha, like hell I would!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I got upset with you over something like
this,
there's no way we woulda made it this far
in the first place.
…Good. Yeah, that's always been you, Ace.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
You never give up. You never get discouraged.
You just keep on running straight ahead,
always hot on my heels like the daredevil
you are.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
As if I could ever stop!
When I see someone amazing right in fronta me,
I just gotta keep on chasing them, y'know?
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Announcer
text_block_list.text:
It's time for the Umamusume Spotlight. 
Today's featured Umamusume is Mr. C.B…

text_block_list.name: Umamusumes
text_block_list.text:
—"C.B.'s insane, isn't she?
She's on a totally different level from
us. 
—Apparently she went out on a run again
today even though it's pouring.
I could never."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah… she's awesome.
She's seriously awesome. 
Damnit,
like I'll let someone like her off the
hook—!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
me too! There's no way I'm losing to ya…!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hah… hah…! 
…Eh?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yo! Hard at it as always, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
… you surprised me.
I didn't think anybody else 
would be running in this kind of weather.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha,
what can I say!
Going out for a run and getting drenched
ain't bad every now and then.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on,
Mr. C.B.! The name's Katsuragi Ace.
Don't forget it—
the name of the Umamusume who came to run
with you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Kuh… Hah… haa… gh! 
… Damn it! DAMN IT!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah… heh… hehe! 
… Hah…

(Damn it,
I didn't even see where she came from!
They say end closers don't do good on soft
ground,
but she flipped that right on its head!)
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(… No,
that's got nothing to do with it.
She did it 'cause she wanted to.
There's no such thing as logic or reason in
her…!)

… gh, haha. Hahaha! 
Awesome… 'aight, bring it on!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
You're a genius. No two ways about it.
When a normal person would've never been
able to chase me,
let alone overtake me… you floored me tons
of times.
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
But y'know,
that's what spurs me on—
the way you're so unconventional.
'Cause what I'm aiming for is a rebellion
of the norm…!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
That's why this time's no different!
I wanna try stickin' to ya!
Everything I want to do,
the way I want to do it!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You and me— common sense and the past, 
let's shatter it all to bits!

Hehe, you're just raring to go. 
… But,
yeah. I do things the way I want.
And you'll come and dig your teeth into
me.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
That's exactly why there's no place that's
off-limits to us.
I'm sure… we'll soar anywhere.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
Let's do it,
Ace! If I'm being honest—
I quite like watching you go around breaking
walls.
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
good to hear it.
Sit back and watch to your heart's content—
the way an Ace breaks the world's limits!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text: I got myself all fired up, and now this?!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
Ah… ah… achoo! Sheesh… 
why'd it have to snow so damn much?!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The field's covered in plenty of snow,
too. Perhaps we ought to move performance
practice to the gym for now?
Hmm… you sure about that?
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.

text_block_list.text: Huh?! W-wait, C.B.-san…?!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Look,
don'tcha think this is fun in its own
way? 
C'mon, Ace! Take off that coat!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, not again… I swear! 
Fine, fine, I'm comin', C.B…!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(C.B.-san and Ace-san ran off together with
not a moment to stop them. Then,
together in sync,
they kicked off of the ground—)

text_block_list.name: C.B. & Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah! 
Hiyaaah!

(It's as if they were soaring through the sky!
The snow they kicked up fluttered around them,
sparkling,
reflecting the brilliance of the sun.)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text: Gh, it's… so bright…
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …C.B., Ace… did you just…

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: … We synced up.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'd always been a second too late… but just
now, we—!
Yeah! It was perfect!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I tried to match your speed,
the faster 
I tried to flip, the worse my form got…

But I was so worried about slippin' on the
snow just now,
it felt like my senses got a lot sharper
without realizing!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
I see… so that's what got you to demolish
that wall you spoke of. Rather,
you could say we've got another predicament
on our hands now…
text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf

text_block_list.text:
Hehe… Ahahaha! So you used that as fuel too,
huh, Ace? Sounds about right!
text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Never thought the snowy ground would make
our performance better.
That's real unconventional of you!
Ahahaha!

Hahahaha! You're the one person 
I don't wanna hear that from!
text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace

text_block_list.text:
(C.B.-san… and Ace-san,
too. They're just… so bright…)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
(They break down every wall like it's nothing.
That radiance is just overwhelming…)
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan

text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro Ramonu is in top shape.
She's as beautiful as ever. 
—Indeed. When she dances,
she shines just like a precious gemstone…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: …Gh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: (Oh, Ardan-chan…)
